name: NZ Steel and Timber
source: Section data from the Revit steel families (UB axes corrected; HST properties left out). Bolt clearances from the Revit reference schedules. Timber from the supplier literature: Prolam Product List 2025, Futurebuild LVL design guides (2019, 2022) and SG8 stock sizes; Timber gauged is from the Revit type names (rows marked check).

categories.name: Timber gauged
categories.note: Sawn and gauged framing, depth x breadth in mm, from the Revit types Timber Framing and TIMBER GAUGED. Sizes are as named; grade and treatment are only filled in where the type name gives them. Check against NZS 3604 / the supplier before use. 2/ = two pieces side by side.

categories.name: Bolts
categories.note: minEdge and minPitch: enter from your NZS 3404 source; 0 = not set (no check).

categories.name: SG8 radiata
categories.note: SG8 machine stress graded radiata pine, dry dressed, as stocked in NZ (H1.2 inside, H3.2 exposed above ground). Section properties are geometric.

categories.name: hySPAN LVL
categories.note: Futurebuild LVL (Carter Holt Harvey). Sizes from the Residential Design Guide NZ, August 2022, Table 1; mass from the Specific Engineering Design Guide, August 2019. Section properties are geometric. Check strength with the Futurebuild design guides or designIT.

categories.name: hy90 LVL
categories.note: Futurebuild LVL (Carter Holt Harvey). Sizes from the Residential Design Guide NZ, August 2022, Table 1; mass from the Specific Engineering Design Guide, August 2019. Section properties are geometric. Check strength with the Futurebuild design guides or designIT.

categories.name: hyONE LVL
categories.note: Futurebuild LVL (Carter Holt Harvey). Sizes from the Residential Design Guide NZ, August 2022, Table 1; mass from the Specific Engineering Design Guide, August 2019. Section properties are geometric. Check strength with the Futurebuild design guides or designIT.

categories.name: hyCHORD LVL
categories.note: Futurebuild LVL (Carter Holt Harvey). Sizes from the Residential Design Guide NZ, August 2022, Table 1; mass from the Specific Engineering Design Guide, August 2019. Section properties are geometric. Check strength with the Futurebuild design guides or designIT.

categories.name: I-joists (hyJOIST)
categories.note: hyJOIST engineered I-joists (LVL flanges, plywood web), Futurebuild LVL Specific Engineering Design Guide, August 2019, Table 15: d overall depth, b flange width, tf flange thickness, tw nominal web thickness.

categories.name: Glulam beams PL8 (Prolam)
categories.note: Prolam PL8 glulam beams, finished sizes from the Prolam Product List 2025. code is the nominal size in the product code (PLVL8H3-300100 = 290x88 visual H3.2). Visual widths 42 to 260, non-visual 42, 63, 90 and 140. Section properties are geometric. H5, untreated and custom sizes on request.

categories.name: Glulam beams PL12 (Prolam)
categories.note: Prolam PL12 glulam beams, finished sizes from the Prolam Product List 2025. code is the nominal size in the product code (PLVL12H3-300100 = 290x88 visual H3.2). Visual widths 42 to 260, non-visual 42, 63, 90 and 140. Section properties are geometric. H5, untreated and custom sizes on request.

categories.name: Glulam posts (Prolam)
categories.note: Prolam laminated posts, finished sizes from the Prolam Product List 2025: H5 visual posts in PL8 and PL12, H4 landscaping posts. The number in the code is the nominal size.

categories.name: PLX20 and PLX Column (Prolam)
categories.note: Prolam PLX steel-reinforced glulam, non-visual H1.2, Prolam Product List 2025. Drawn as the timber outline; check capacities with Prolam.

categories.name: Joist hangers (Lumberlok)

categories.name: Glulam (grade 7)
categories.note: South African glulam, grade 7 (grades up to 12 on order), sizes from RSB Group: thickness 38 to 165, depth 67 to 622. Not every combination is made; check with the supplier. Section properties are geometric.

categories.name: Bolts
categories.note: minEdge and minPitch: enter from your NZS 3404 source; 0 = not set (no check). The same metric bolts are used in South Africa (grades 4.8 and 8.8).
